title: 03 · Watch trio: three faces on generic cases
strengths: The three faces are strong and read in a second: '4\'52"' pace in lime, '6:18' with a tide curve, the '2 MIN' transit countdown
The case bevels are drawn with care: a chamfered rim, a highlight on the top edge, a ridged crown
slop_signals: The case is an Apple Watch silhouette: rounded-square glass, a ridged digital crown and a flat side button on the right, a fluoroelastomer-style strap with pin holes; no other watch looks like this, so 'generic' is not true
The straps are flat dark bands with a column of dots and no edge, stitching or curvature; they read as rectangles behind the cases
The background is three vertical soft bands (lighter centre, darker sides) that read as stripes rather than a studio falloff
The faces are rendered at full brightness with no glass reflection, so they look placed on the case rather than under its crystal
fixes: Redraw the case so it is nobody's: a round or softly squared case with a crown at 2 o'clock, or a flat-top case with two pushers; change the strap to a woven or leather band with visible edges and a buckle
Light it as one scene: a single key from the upper left, a rim on the opposite edge, and a floor shadow; remove the vertical bands
Add a 3% white sweep across each crystal and darken the face 10% toward the edges
Or photograph a real generic watch (open licence) and map the faces onto it

references.what: The real hardware ours resembles: rounded-square case, crown and side button on the right, sport strap; the plate should look like something else
Wearables shot with one soft light on fabric; the material and the falloff do the selling
Hardware on black with one key light and a soft floor glow; the falloff our background wants instead of bands
Several devices on a flat grey field in frames with no brand cues; proves generic frames can hold real screens

owner.said: when designs are bad, mockups will also be bad; work on them
